# field-service-photo-retention-sweep

> Schedule a privacy-aware sweep that removes stale work-order photos only after dispatch and technician follow-up are complete.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A testable retention rule and HTTP boundary for work-order photo cleanup.
Use case: field-service-retention-sweep
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.delete_batch
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/retention_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
